title: RRHF: Rank Responses to Align Language Models with Human Feedback without tears
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical training paradigm (RRHF) designed for aligning LLMs with human preferences. While it evaluates 'harmlessness' using the Anthropic Helpful and Harmless dataset, this is a standard safety alignment task and the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
